subject: Request: 60-day trial extension + combined credits/discount (Helioport)
messages:
From: Alice Peters <alice.peters@helioport.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Trial pause + extension + credits/discount ask

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick kickoff last week. We’ve run through the integration tests and the team is excited about the latency improvements we saw on the Redwood hosted stack. That said, we burned through our evaluation credits faster than expected when we started a large end-to-end test of our ingestion pipeline.

Can Redwood do the following as an exception so we can finish a production smoke test and accelerate the procurement conversation?

- 60‑day trial extension on our current sandbox (no change to data residency)
- $25,000 in free inference credits applied to the account for the next 90 days (usage-first)
- 20% introductory discount on the first 12 months of committed usage if we sign an annual agreement by Apr 30

We’re working on an internal PO but the CFO (cc’d) is asking for the commercial commitment and an updated SOW. I’ve attached a draft SOW with the proposed milestones.

Appreciate if you can route this for exec approval — this is time-sensitive for our April procurement window.

Thanks,
Alice Peters
Head of Integrations
Helioport Systems
attachment: Helioport_SOW-draft.pdf (PDF)

Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 12:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial pause + extension + credits/discount ask

Alice — thanks for the note and the SOW.

I’ve looped in Marissa (VP Sales) and Aditya (Revenue Ops) to review the commercial ask, and Grace from CS to confirm there are no platform/ops constraints on the sandbox extension. High level — 60 days + credits + a signing incentive is a reasonable approach but needs a quick exec exception sign-off because it’s outside our standard starter bundle.

Marissa / Aditya / Grace — see request below from Helioport. Quick summary: 60‑day extension, $25k free credits (usage-based), and 20% discount on year-one if they sign within the month. They need an updated SOW and a PO. Please advise approval path and any binding conditions (PO, commit level, CS runbook).

Alice — I’ll get back to you before EOD with next steps.

Best,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial pause + extension + credits/discount ask (internal)

Jonas —

Quick battleground numbers and recommendation: 

- $25k free credits (usage-based): estimated marginal cost to Redwood ~ $8k given typical burst profiles. This assumes they don’t run continuous 100% utilization; CS should gate with a hard quota and weekly usage reports.
- 60‑day sandbox extension: operationally fine — Grace, confirm there’s no added infra cost beyond today’s pool.
- 20% year-one discount if signed by Apr 30: revenue impact depends on expected ARR. If expected first-year committed run-rate is $200k, that’s ~$40k discount; recommend tying the discount to a 12‑month minimum commitment of $150k ARR to protect unit economics.

My recommendation: approve the extension + $25k credits + 20% discount conditional on:
  * PO or signed MSA addendum within 30 days;
  * Minimum 12‑month commit of $150k ARR (or scaled credits to match lower commit);
  * CS onboarding runbook & kickoff within 7 business days of agreement;
  * Weekly usage check-ins and a hard quota on credits to avoid runaway spend.

I’ve attached an approval matrix for finance to sign-off quickly. If Aditya concurs, I’ll move it to exec signoff template and authorize Jonas to confirm to the customer.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Global Sales | Redwood Inference
attachment: Approval_Matrix.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial pause + extension + credits/discount ask (final approval)

Marissa / team —

I reviewed the numbers and the ask. Given the strategic fit (Helioport is targeting a production rollout for Q3 and cites multi-region requirements), I approve the exception with the conditions Marissa outlined.

Conditions for approval (must be included in the commercial addendum):
1) 60‑day sandbox extension from time of signature
2) $25,000 free credits valid for 90 days post-issue, capped and monitored weekly
3) 20% discount applied to year-one committed usage only, contingent on a 12‑month minimum commit of $150,000 ARR
4) Signed PO/MSA addendum by Apr 30, 2027 or the credits/discount offer expires
5) CS onboarding timeline (kickoff within 7 business days) and weekly usage reports for first 90 days

Jonas — you can communicate this to Helioport and attach the addendum template. Finance will pre-clear the accounting treatment; Grace, coordinate runbook.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Alice / Nathan —

Thanks for the SOW and the clear timeline. Good news — we can approve an exception to support your April procurement window. Summary of what’s approved (conditions below):

Approved (exception):
- 60‑day trial/sandbox extension
- $25,000 in free inference credits (usage-based), valid for 90 days from issuance
- 20% discount on year-one committed usage if Helioport signs a 12‑month minimum commitment of $150,000 ARR by Apr 30, 2027

Conditions / next steps:
1) We will prepare an MSA addendum reflecting the credit cap, the 12‑month commit, and the discount; please return a signed PO or the signed addendum by Apr 30 to secure the offer.
2) CS will run an onboarding plan and schedule a kickoff within 7 business days of sign-off; Grace will reach out to schedule.
3) The $25k credits will be applied as a usage allowance and will be capped; we will provide weekly usage summaries for the first 90 days.
4) If the PO/addendum isn’t returned by Apr 30 the offer expires.

I’ll attach the addendum and the approval matrix to the DocuSign envelope. Link: https://docusign.net/envelope/ABCDEF-123456.

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk the SOW changes.

Best,
Jonas Weber
